description: This false-colour infrared aerial or satellite image displays agricultural land, specifically vineyards, located in Loutsa, Island of Evia, Greece. The image shows a mosaic of distinct, geometrically shaped land parcels, which are delineated by thin white lines indicating field boundaries. Areas of dense, healthy vegetation, consistent with actively cultivated vineyards and other crops, appear in vibrant red hues due to high reflectance in the near-infrared spectrum. Other land cover types, likely including less vigorous vegetation or bare soil, are rendered in shades of light green and teal. A prominent, winding linear feature, also appearing reddish-brown, traverses the landscape, potentially indicating a watercourse or vegetated riparian zone. The image illustrates diverse patterns of land use and cultivation. The image is credited to N. Kolpatzik.
